goal: Add a /todos REST API with SQLite storage and pagination
assumptions: Router is the existing chi router in internal/http

tasks.title: Add SQLite connection and todos migration
tasks.spec: Create internal/store/db.go with Open(path) that opens SQLite and applies embedded migrations. Add migration 001_todos.sql: todos(id INTEGER PK, title TEXT NOT NULL, done BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL).
acceptance: Open(':memory:') succeeds and the todos table exists
Running migrations twice does not fail

tasks.title: Add DB_PATH to config
tasks.spec: Extend internal/config with DBPath read from env DB_PATH, default './data.db'.

tasks.title: Todo repository (CRUD)
tasks.spec: internal/store/todos.go: type TodoRepo with Create, Get, List(limit, offset), Update, Delete. Return ErrNotFound for missing ids.
acceptance: Each method has a table-driven test against :memory:
Get on a missing id returns ErrNotFound

tasks.title: REST handlers for /todos
tasks.spec: internal/http/todos.go: GET /todos, POST /todos, GET/PATCH/DELETE /todos/{id}. JSON in/out, 404 on ErrNotFound, 400 on invalid body. Wire into the router and main using config.DBPath.
acceptance: httptest covers each route, including the 400 and 404 cases
The server starts with `go run ./cmd/server` and POST then GET round-trips

tasks.title: Offset pagination on GET /todos
tasks.spec: Support ?limit (default 20, max 100) and ?offset. Response: {items, total, limit, offset}. Invalid values → 400.
acceptance: total is correct when there are more items than fit on a page

tasks.title: Document the /todos API
tasks.spec: Add docs/api/todos.md with each endpoint, request/response examples and error codes.
acceptance: Every route in internal/http/todos.go is documented with an example
